title: Correct the roles of product classifications, dictionaries and coding
requirements:
- State the purpose and product level of UNSPSC, GPC, ATC and WHODrug; they are not identifiers
- Note that shelf labels aligned to the national registry may be needed where manufacturer codes are absent or equivalent products are pooled
- Document licensing and governance per classification
- Define IDMP and scope it to medicinal products
- Categorise listed standards by role and normativity
